pilot.purpose: materialization, comprehension, timing, qualification, ambiguity, and leakage only

primary.aggregation_rule: within each source task group, any contradiction yields contradicted; otherwise any unresolved yields unresolved; only complete support yields supported
primary.replacement_rule: none; the exact 31-case commitment is immutable and every unavailable case remains visible
primary.missingness_rule: missing, late, partial, conflicted, or insufficient judgments resolve unresolved and remain in every case and task-group denominator
primary.stopping_rule: fixed sample; stop only after all 31 cases reach committed dual review plus required tie-break or explicit unresolved state; no sequential efficacy stopping

inference.primary_estimand: source-task-group prevalence of formal-human contradiction with unresolved groups retained separately
inference.interval_method: one-sided exact binomial upper confidence bound at the source-task-group level
inference.multiplicity_method: one prespecified global primary endpoint; family, class, split, and control rows are descriptive and cannot replace it
inference.family_analysis_role: descriptive bounded construct evidence only; no per-family validation or universal error-rate claim
inference.unresolved_denominator_rule: unresolved is never pooled with support, never dropped, and never converted by majority vote
inference.independence_limitation: exact binomial resolution assumes independent sampled task groups; the governed corpus is not a probability sample, so the bound is a design diagnostic rather than population generalization

claim_boundary: report blinded reviewers' support, contradiction, and unresolved states only for the named sampled tasks under the frozen material and rubric; do not claim universal construct validity, verifier robustness, or human ground truth
